project_type: Flutter mobile/web app (BrainBuddies): a comic-styled hub of 6 educational mini-games for kids grades 1-3. Package name `brain_buddies`. Web is the primary verification target.
build_system: Flutter. On this Windows machine Flutter is called explicitly as `& "$env:USERPROFILE\flutter\bin\flutter.bat" <cmd>`. Shell is PowerShell: use `;` not `&&`, and `$env:VAR` not `%VAR%`.
test_framework: flutter_test + shared_preferences test mock. Tests live under test/. Use `SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({...})` and `TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized()`. Widget tests set a phone surface via `tester.view.physicalSize = const Size(430, 900)` (or 1000) with resets in addTearDown.
verification_instructions: 1) build web MUST succeed — success = the line `Built build\web` is present in output; a trailing Select-String `Exit Code: 1` with no matches AFTER the Built line is NOT a failure. 2) `flutter test` MUST pass (15 tests exist before this task; the count only grows). 3) Do NOT run `flutter analyze` — it CRASHES because the project path contains non-ASCII (Hebrew) characters. Rely on build web as the compiler check.
snapshot_or_generated_files: null — no generated/snapshot files are checked in for this task. `flutter build web` writes to build/web (not committed).
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Work ONLY in the existing worktree at c:\Users\USER\OneDrive\מסמכים\Math Adventure\.worktrees\review-improvements on branch feature/review-improvements. Do NOT create a worktree, do NOT branch from main, do NOT merge, do NOT push. Relative paths resolve against the PARENT workspace, so always use absolute paths rooted at the worktree. `flutter analyze` crashes on the Hebrew path; `smart_relocate` does not rewrite Dart imports here — fix imports manually and confirm with build web.
contribution_requirements: Match the comic style: thick ink borders (AppTheme.comicBorder), hard offset shadows (AppTheme.comicShadow), palette (AppTheme.accent/primary/ink/success/danger/sky). Prefer const constructors. Never size widgets from MediaQuery.of(context).size.width — use LayoutBuilder/constraints.maxWidth (app is capped to a 430px phone frame). Extension methods need their defining file imported even if the type arrives transitively. Keep SoundBridge.enabled in sync with the sound setting on load/toggle/reset. Shared state (coins/avatar/achievements/streak/pet/missions) lives in core PlayerProfile; per-game progress (stars/fastest/XP) stays in the game's own store. Reusable UI goes in lib/core/widgets. Game->core import depth is ../../../core/...
key_patterns: Each game has: a world/level model with `allLevels` in play order, a question generator with static `forLevel(level, {Random? random})` that de-duplicates within a round (seen-set + ~25-try guard), a ChangeNotifier state store with per-level stars/fastest + isLevelUnlocked + completeLevel, and four screens (home world-select, trail/map, game with live TimerChip, result). Five sibling stores extend GameProgressStore (SafariState, WizardState, ClockState, MoneyState, MemoryState) sharing starsForPercent (>=90->3, >=70->2, >=50->1), keepBestStars, recordFastestIfBest (3-star + improves only), and isLevelUnlockedById. Number Quest's GameState is standalone (nq_ keys + XP). Games report hub progress with one call: profile.onRoundFinished(correct, coinsEarned, threeStars, bossBeaten).
